config.potion_expire_sounds.title: Potion Expire Sounds Config
config.potion_expire_sounds.enable_mod.d: Enables or disables the entire mod. When disabled, no sounds are played and the HUD is hidden.
config.potion_expire_sounds.play_warning: Plays a sound when a status effect drops below the warning threshold.
Plays a countdown sound every second while a status effect has 3-1 seconds remaining.
config.potion_expire_sounds.play_expire_: Plays a sound when a status effect expires.
config.potion_expire_sounds.warning_thre: Time in seconds before expiry at which the warning sound is triggered.
config.potion_expire_sounds.volume_expir: Volume of the sound played when a status effect expires.
config.potion_expire_sounds.pitch_expire: Pitch of the sound played when a status effect expires.
config.potion_expire_sounds.volume_warni: Volume of the sound played when a status effect crosses the warning threshold.
config.potion_expire_sounds.pitch_warnin: Pitch of the sound played when a status effect crosses the warning threshold.
config.potion_expire_sounds.list_type.de: Sets whether the effect list acts as a blacklist (excluded effects) or a whitelist (only listed effects are processed).
config.potion_expire_sounds.sound.potion: Sound event played when a status effect expires. Leave empty to use the default sound.
Sound event played when a status effect crosses the warning threshold. Leave empty to use the default sound.
config.potion_expire_sounds.potion_hud.t: Shows or hides the Potion HUD above the hotbar.
config.potion_expire_sounds.potion_hud.o: Opens the drag-and-drop editor to reposition the Potion HUD on screen.
Determines whether the filter applies to sounds, the HUD, or both.
config.potion_expire_sounds.potion_hud.s: Whether to show effects with infinite duration in the Potion HUD.
config.potion_expire_sounds.potion_hud.c: Enables compact mode: only the effect with the shortest remaining duration per group is shown.
Adjusts the size of the effect icons displayed in the Compact Potion HUD.
config.potion_expire_sounds.combat.sound: Sound event played when Strength expires. Leave empty to use the default expire sound.
Sound event played when Strength crosses the warning threshold. Leave empty to use the default warning sound.
